source_context: Bulk sandbox historical replay evidence pilot v0.2. Synthetic seed evidence for attribution-learning pipeline testing; not production evidence.
evidence_items: Singapore Total Manufacturing output in 2009 was affected by a demand shock, external downturn, and weak global demand conditions.
Export decline, lower exports, order slowdown, and trade slowdown weighed on production activity.
A sharp demand fall and global recession conditions transmitted into Singapore's industrial base.
Manufacturing output reflected weaker external demand and disruption to regional activity.
